decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - All new external finishes in respect of all works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.

Condition : 4 - Full details, with samples, of the stall riser and the open fly screen shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing 2 months after the start of works. The development shall not be carried otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.
